svg.aria-label: Data flow, table by table. Sources: the eight CSV files in data/input/. Python (analysis.ipynb): one pandas table per file, then sale_orders (96,478 delivered orders), o (the late rule), latest_review (98,673) and REGION_OF (27 states). Power BI: Power Query loads fact_sales (110,197 rows, built from items, o and latest_review), dim_product, dim_seller, dim_customer and report_settings from output/; dim_date (1,096 days) is DAX; _Measures holds 23 DAX measures. Report pages: 5 pages and 56 visuals. 34 lines, one per table read.
svg.title: Sales performance data flow

g.text: One box per table, one line per table it reads; counts from the notebook's last run
